notes.title: We're excited to be a part of the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076764/a61dc427f547ea8b38034f5b12fbec3df08ec0b2.png

We’re excited to announce our participation in the Steam Next Fest!

Try the demo for Wizard of Wings: Escape today!
We’d love to hear your feedback, so feel free to reach out to us via the Steam Community Hub.
Watch the trailer:
[previewyoutube=i-F_Wy9D9lY;full][/previewyoutube]
Wizard of Wings: Escape is a puzzle-adventure room escape game where you solve intricate puzzles set against breathtaking 3D visuals. Explore detailed environments to uncover hidden clues and gather useful objects as you embark on a captivating journey to free the birds and progress through each level.
